title: Horse Tinder
angle: Dating, but for horses, played completely straight: the film treats a horse finding a match with the gravity of a fintech launch. The product UI is rebuilt from the app's own components and shown one detail at a time.

scenes.name: Hook
scenes.visual: Kinetic type on the brand background; the real swipe-right button arrives under the last word.
scenes.motion: Per-word slam on the beat, then the button springs in.

scenes.name: Reveal
scenes.visual: The profile card rebuilt from ProfileCard.tsx: photo, name 'Biscuit, 7', 'Enjoys long gallops'. The rest of the deck is quiet placeholder cards behind it.
scenes.motion: Card rises into focus, the deck settles behind it, a slow push-in on the name.
scenes.narration: Meet Biscuit. [pause 0.3] Seven, enjoys long gallops.

scenes.name: Demo
scenes.visual: The rebuilt card again, now with the cursor: it travels to the swipe-right button, presses, and the 'It's a match' state from MatchBanner.tsx lands.
scenes.motion: Cursor travels, press ripple, card flies right, match banner springs in on the cue.
scenes.narration: One swipe, {match} and it's a match.

scenes.name: Proof
scenes.visual: The real counter component from Stats.tsx rolling up to the number in the README.
scenes.motion: Number wheel rolls and lands, label rises after it.

scenes.name: End card
scenes.visual: The real logo from brand/logo.svg strokes on, then the URL.
scenes.motion: Logo paths draw on, settle, URL types in; hold 2 s.

share_copy: Swipe right on horses. Horse Tinder is live at horsetinder.app.
